channel.title: Briefing
channel.description: A personal audio briefing of tech and world news.

item.title: UK announces sanctions on West Bank settlements prompting furious Israeli response
item.description: The United Kingdom has announced a comprehensive sanctions regime targeting illegal Israeli settlements in the occupied West Bank. This bans settlement goods and advertising and services linked to settlement expansion. Foreign Secretary Ed Miliband told members of parliament that the action marks the beginning of a new approach to the conflict. He launched the action alongside France and Canada. He accused the Israeli government of turning a blind eye to the ethnic cleansing of Palestinians by settlers. Miliband stated that the United Kingdom views the occupation as unlawful. He cited a twenty twenty-four advisory opinion from the International Court of Justice. He announced that the new sanctions will be introduced over the next six to nine months. The decision follows Israel opening tenders to build approximately one thousand two hundred settlement homes in the E1 area east of Jerusalem. Israel Foreign Minister Gideon Saar denounced the move as an outrageous lie. He shut the United Kingdom consulate in East Jerusalem. Israel banned eleven United Kingdom members of parliament from entering the country. Israel retaliated by terminating British military training programs. Saar stated that the hostile Labour government left Israel no choice but to respond. President Isaac Herzog warned the decision would fall on the wrong side of history. The United Kingdom also issued a joint statement with eleven other nations pledging support for the two-state solution and restricting trade with settlements.

item.title: Supreme Court forces TV stations to sell more election ads at steep discounts
item.description:
The Supreme Court issued an order on Friday, September fourth. This is a victory for Republican campaign committees.
The order forces broadcast television stations to cut the prices of election ads. Political parties and joint fundraising committees purchase these ads.
The National Republican Congressional Committee and the National Republican Senatorial Committee filed a petition. The ruling came in response to that petition.
The order arrived just in time for the start of a sixty-day period before the election. United States law requires broadcasters to offer ad discounts to individual candidates during this time.
Television stations must now also give their lowest ad rates to political parties and joint fundraising committees. These groups face fewer limits on how much money they can raise and spend.
The legally required discount is known as the lowest unit charge, or L. U. C.
A United States law applies to any licensed station airing election ads. It requires stations to charge the lowest price for the use of any broadcasting station.
This rule applies to any person who is a legally qualified candidate for any public office. They must use the station in connection with their campaign.
The main legal question centered on a specific issue. Investigators asked whether the use by a candidate refers to ad time purchased on a candidate's behalf. Political parties and joint fundraising committees buy this ad time.

item.title: What is Roku's secret menu and how do you unlock it?
item.description:
Roku devices contain hidden menus that you can reach with remote control button combinations. These menus act as shortcuts to performance settings and diagnostics and network tools. Eighteen years after the debut of the device, these backend menus let users sideload applications and run speed tests and manage developer accounts and troubleshoot hardware.
You can reach the developer menu to access the developer installer and manage developer accounts. Press Home three times and Up twice and Right and Left and Right and Left and Right.
You can access network settings including I. P. and M. A. C. addresses and bandwidth saver mode. Press Home five times and Right and Left and Right and Left and Right.
A wireless secret screen lets you check signal strength and glitch rates and speed tests and network resets. Reach this screen by pressing Home five times and Up and Down and Up and Down and Up.
Secret screen two is used for adjusting ad channels and image service and screenshot output formats. Access this screen by pressing Home five times and Up and Right and Down and Left and Up. Users may need to restart the device for ad preferences to change.
The platform secret screen displays operational information such as memory usage and remote battery levels and device temperature. It also shows diagnostics including I. P. v. six settings and R. F. remote diagnostics. Access it by pressing Home five times and Fast Forward and Down and Rewind and Down and Fast Forward.
You can reach H. D. M. I. settings for inputs and refresh rates and resolution performance. Press Home five times and Down and Left and Up and Up and Up.
The channel info menu is used to check application versions and troubleshoot and uninstall or reboot apps. Reach this menu by pressing Home three times and Up twice and Left and Right and Left and Right and Left.
You can initiate direct device reboots by pressing Home five times and Up and Rewind twice and Fast Forward twice.

item.title: New report shows the economic toll of ICE raids
item.description:
Immigration crackdowns that began in early twenty twenty-five drained over one point two six billion dollars from local businesses in Cook County, Illinois. A new study from the University of Illinois Chicago revealed these findings using anonymous cellphone G. P. S. data. Regular travel between immigrant and non-immigrant neighborhoods collapsed almost immediately after President Donald Trump took office on January twentieth, twenty twenty-five, amid rumors and sweeps of I. C. E. raids.
This decreased consumer mobility cost retail shops and restaurants in non-immigrant areas approximately one point two six billion dollars. It also cost Illinois one hundred seven million dollars in lost tax revenue. Co-author Professor Matt Wilson told N. P. R. that the city has yet to recover. He stated they saw a nine percent drop in retail and a ten percent drop in restaurant visits. These drops persisted for about a year with systematically changed consumer behavior.
Nationwide, the administration policies resulted in hundreds of thousands of arrests. The immigration detention population sits at a record high of approximately sixty-five thousand people. White House spokesperson Lauren Bis defended the enforcement strategy in a statement to N. P. R. She said that removing criminals makes communities safer. She added that nearly seventy percent of I. C. E. arrests are of illegal aliens charged or convicted of a crime.
Meanwhile, I. C. E. statistics show that roughly seventy percent of those currently detained have no criminal convictions. The report also highlights broader economic impacts across the country. Minneapolis saw an estimated seven hundred million dollars in total economic damage. Small businesses there lost over eighty-one million dollars in January alone. The Brookings Institution also estimated a one point seven percentage point decline in aggregate consumer spending in high enforcement states.

item.title: From the Corps to the Cosmos, featuring Jaden Caradine
item.description:
Jaden Caradine is a Pathways intern at the National Aeronautics and Space Administration, known as N. A. S. A., Langley Research Center in Hampton, Virginia. He spent five years as a United States Marine Corps mechanic with four of those years stationed in Japan.
Caradine later transferred to Embry-Riddle Aeronautical University to study aerospace engineering. At N. A. S. A. Langley, he joined the Systems Analysis and Concepts Directorate. He worked specifically with the in-space servicing, assembly, and manufacturing team.
His reason for choosing N. A. S. A. over industry was simple and firm. He noted that N. A. S. A. does not work for profit. Instead, the agency removes barriers so that industry can innovate further.
Caradine stated that N. A. S. A. is there to remove barriers so industry can eventually do things they were not able to do before. During his time there, he helped curate the State of Play document. This resource consolidates in-space servicing, assembly, and manufacturing sector activities across government, academia, and industry.
He also built an automated tool that scrapes aerospace news to streamline team updates. Dale Arney, an aerospace engineer and mentor to Caradine, noted that Jaden joined the team and immediately contributed to the update while creating a tool to speed up future reports.

item.title: Iran launched fresh attack on US navy ships Monday amid China, Russia aid fears
item.description: Iran launched a fresh attack targeting United States navy ships on Monday. This followed similar ballistic missile strikes over the weekend. Those weekend strikes were aimed at a United States aircraft carrier and a guided missile destroyer. No United States warships were hit in the incidents. The incidents have not yet been acknowledged by the United States military. In response to the weekend carrier targeting, the United States struck three Iranian oil tankers. Washington stated those tankers were funding the military of Iran and proxy groups. The repeated attacks have raised concerns among United States officials. Officials are concerned that Iran is employing more advanced weapons. Iran is also potentially receiving tracking assistance from China or Russia. Iranian state media claimed the country is using new missiles with advanced technology. Weapons analysts note these could include electro optical seekers. Those seekers use images to adjust trajectories toward moving targets., John Caves, a senior research associate at the Wisconsin Project on Nuclear Arms Control, stated something important. He stated that Iran unveiled the Qassem Bassir medium range ballistic missile with such seeker technology last year. He also stated that other Iranian missiles, including the Khalij Fars, use it too. The escalation comes as a United States blockade of Iranian ports increases economic pressure on the country. A United States navy official noted that nineteen warships are currently supporting operations in the Middle East. Washington has warned it will respond to attacks on its naval vessels. The United States hopes sanctions will ultimately force Iranian leadership to back down.

item.title: US strikes Iranian tankers after attempted missile attacks on its Navy warship: Report
item.description: On Tuesday, September eighth, the United States struck multiple Iranian oil tankers. This followed attempted missile attacks that targeted a U. S. Navy warship. The Associated Press reported the strikes, citing an anonymous U. S. official. Iranian media separately reported that a U. S. projectile struck a small tanker about four miles from Kharg Island. Kharg Island is a key oil export hub, and no casualties were reported from that strike. Blasts were also heard on Kharg Island and in the southern port of Jask. Ahead of the strikes, Iran's Revolutionary Guard Navy warned tanker crews near Kuwait and Bahrain to immediately leave their vessels. They stated the ships would be targeted. Iranian Armed Forces chief of staff, Ali Abdollahi warned that Tehran would target U. S. military bases across the region in retaliation. Meanwhile, the Revolutionary Guard stated it intercepted and destroyed an M. Q.-one drone over the Strait of Hormuz using a new advanced defence system. The military escalation drove international benchmark Brent crude to briefly reach ninety-nine dollars and forty-six cents a barrel on Tuesday. In tandem with the strikes, the U. S. Treasury announced sanctions against thirty-six entities. The sanctions target all remaining Iranian airlines not previously penalized. Officials accused the aviation sector of transporting weapons and illicit cargo. Despite the military escalation, Iran stated that diplomatic efforts were making progress. Foreign Minister, Abbas Araghchi noted that talks with Oman on managing the strategic waterway had achieved significant progress. Meanwhile, U. S. Secretary of State, Marco Rubio accused Iran of orchestrating recent attacks by Houthi rebels against Saudi Arabia. In Lebanon, Israeli airstrikes in the south on Monday killed thirteen people. The Lebanese Health Ministry provided this casualty count, marking an escalation after weeks of calm.

item.title: Bombardier points out U.S. footprint after Trump says aerospace giant must build in America
item.description:
Canadian airplane manufacturer Bombardier responded to demands from President Donald Trump that the company build in America by highlighting its existing United States footprint.
On Monday, Trump wrote on Truth Social that Bombardier must build in the United States to access the local market. He stated that they must stop treating America like a piggybank and declared no more selling Bombardier in the United States.
In a statement to CNBC, Bombardier noted that it has direct employment in more than twenty states and sites in ten states, including California, Texas, Arizona, and Kansas. Senator Jerry Moran noted that Bombardier supports a local workforce of more than one thousand employees in Wichita.
The company also stated its aircraft are built with American-made components such as engines and avionics. It plans to grow its defense activities and service network, and it will inaugurate a new facility in Fort Wayne, Indiana, later this year. The company said it values its great partnership with American companies and its United States employees.
Trump's demand arrived on the eve of Canada imposing retaliatory tariffs on about twenty billion dollars of United States goods. This mirrored the size of Trump's recent fifty percent import taxes on Canadian wine, cement, hockey sticks, and other products following a breakdown in trade talks.
Hours after the Canadian duties took effect, Trump declared on Truth Social that products originating in Canada should be ineligible for government commercial procurement programs. He wrote that there will be no reciprocity and no access.
United States Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick told CNBC that Canadians blew up a nearly complete trade deal for political reasons. Canadian Prime Minister Mark Carney stated his nation would resume trade talks when the Americans are ready.

item.title: Probe ordered into police action against protesting Bhopal intern doctors
item.description:
Bhopal Police Commissioner Sanjay Kumar ordered an inquiry into police action against protesting M. B. B. S. intern doctors. The directive came from Deputy Chief Minister and Health Minister Rajendra Shukla.
On September seventh, twenty twenty-six, hundreds of interns from Gandhi Medical College protested on their campus. They demanded a stipend hike from fourteen thousand four hundred thirty-seven rupees to thirty thousand rupees.
Protestors planned a march toward the Chief Minister residence. Police deployed water cannons and resorted to a baton charge near the campus. This stopped the march less than two kilometers from the destination.
At least four interns suffered serious injuries. These included a broken arm and an eye injury.
Interns launched an overnight sit-in at Kamla Park on September seventh and eighth. They boycotted outpatient department and routine operation theatre services while maintaining emergency care. Services were also disrupted at Gajra Raja Medical College in solidarity.
Siddhartha Kumar Rai, president of the Junior Doctors Association undergraduate student wing, spoke about the event. He stated that the peaceful protestors work thirty-six hour duties and handle heavy patient loads, yet they were treated like goons.
Kavita N. Singh criticized the police action in a letter to Commissioner Kumar. She called the use of force without prior notice completely inappropriate. She demanded action against responsible officers.
Vikas Sahwal, Deputy Commissioner of Police for Zone two, has been appointed to conduct an impartial investigation.

item.title: Haaland double gives Manchester City ideal Champions League start in Porto
item.description:
Erling Haaland scored two goals to give Manchester City a two-nil away victory over Porto. This was their opening match of the Champions League.
The win gives manager Enzo Maresca a perfect start of four wins from four games since succeeding Pep Guardiola. This comes ahead of an upcoming matchday two fixture against Paris Saint-Germain and a Sunday derby against Manchester United.
The first half was scoreless because Porto limited the penetration of City. The visitors broke through immediately after the interval. Rayan Cherki drove into the area and fed Enzo Fernández. The cross from Fernández was headed into the turf and home by Haaland. Porto pushed for an equalizer later in the game. Haaland secured the result late in the match with a right-foot stab.
The victory is significant for City. They had lost six of their past nine away games in the competition. They also lost the twenty twenty-one Champions League final at the same venue. The three points provide a crucial fillip toward the accepted target of sixteen points needed to qualify automatically for the knockout stage. This is particularly important because a difficult home match against the double European champions looms next month.
The side managed the win despite missing a rest for Haaland. They also handed a full debut to Ayyoub Bouaddi in a midfield alongside Fernández. They utilized substitutions including Elliot Anderson and Iliman Ndiaye in the second half. This helped maintain control against the side managed by Francesco Farioli.

item.title: Hackers are stealing Claude tokens from subscribers
item.description: On August fourth, independent A. I. consultant, Grant de Swardt, noticed his Claude Max twenty times account token usage climbing on a day he was not working. After disabling his connected tasks, token consumption increased from forty-five percent to fifty-five percent during a controlled interval with no active local tasks. Anthropic suspended his paid account, invalidated his sessions and server-side Claude Code tokens, and issued a partial refund of forty-four pounds and forty-nine pence for his two hundred dollar per month subscription. After investigating, Anthropic told de Swardt a compromised Claude session key was used to mint unauthorized Claude Code O. Auth tokens, though they could not determine how access was obtained. Other users on Reddit and GitHub reported similar experiences of unexplained token depletion and unauthorized charges. Anthropic subsequently warned some users via email that a bad actor was using infostealer malware to steal Claude login sessions from personal computers. When suspicious activity is detected, the company signs users out, invalidates authorizations, issues refunds, and warns of potential malware. Anthropic stated the malware does not originate from Claude itself. De Swardt, who found no evidence of a compromised computer, had his account reinstated after two weeks but cancelled his subscription for Cursor due to the lack of itemized usage tracking and slow support. Anthropic declined to comment when asked how users can identify misuse.

item.title: Real Madrid beat Inter Milan as Mbappe goal sets Mourinho’s men on way
item.description:
Jose Mourinho’s Real Madrid defeated his former club Inter Milan two to one in a Champions League opener at the Santiago Bernabeu on Tuesday.
Real Madrid President Florentino Perez brought back the Portuguese veteran to try and stop the rot. The team went two seasons without a major trophy and suffered early European exits.
The record fifteen-time European champions capitalized on two first-half defensive errors to build a two-goal lead.
In the fourteenth minute, a poor pass from Curtis Jones placed Yann Bisseck under pressure. That allowed Brahim Diaz to poke the ball through to Kylian Mbappe, who fired home.
Madrid scored their second goal when Inter goalkeeper Josep Martinez dallied on the ball. Fede Valverde pried it away and scored.
Cristian Chivu leads the Inter side. They responded in the second half when Carlos Augusto smashed home a shot past Thibaut Courtois. Lautaro Martinez provided the cross in the seventy-seventh minute.
Real Madrid goalkeeper Thibaut Courtois made several smart saves to ensure his team took all three points.
Visitors applied late pressure. Jude Bellingham and Mbappe missed chances. Madrid still held on to secure the victory.
This win helps them bounce back from their La Liga defeat against Real Betis on Friday.

item.title: Cockroach Milk, How to Blow Your Nose, and Mosquito Printers: The Ig Nobels of 2026
item.description:
The Ig Nobel Prizes held their annual ceremony in Zurich, Switzerland. The organization Improbable Research has hosted these awards since nineteen ninety-one. They recognize ten unusual scientific studies that first make people laugh and then make them think. These awards show that science has a humorous side in its quest to answer meaningful questions.
The biomechanics prize went to researchers who defined a kiss in a specific way. They called it a non-agonistic interaction involving directed intraspecific oral-oral contact. This includes some movement of the lips or oral structures and without the transfer of food.
The economics prize went to a study about social classes. It concluded that people from higher social classes have a greater tendency to prioritize self-interest.
The chemistry prize recognized an analysis of high-protein and energy-dense nutrient crystals. Mother cockroaches of the species Diploptera punctata produce these crystals.
The medicine prize went posthumously to scientist Unno Tokuji. His research recommended that people blow their nose one nostril at a time with a long and forceful exhalation.
The biology prize involved researchers stepping on Bothrops jararaca snakes while wearing a boot. They found a forty-four percent probability of a bite when stepping on the head. There was a twenty percent chance on the body and an eleven percent chance on the tail.
The physics prize focused on mathematical models. These models help design splash-free urinals using lower angles of impact.
The technology prize recognized the use of dead mosquito proboscises. People used them as ultrathin nozzles for three-D printers.
The olfaction prize confirmed a finding about how parents rate smells. Parents rate the smell of young children more favorably than that of teenagers.
The peace prize relied on questionnaires. It found that people generally prefer a friend who is kind to them but cruel to their enemies.
The soil science prize featured about one thousand participants. They buried cotton underwear to assess soil health based on the degree of decomposition.

item.title: LIV files for bankruptcy protection with over $45m owed to players
item.description:
L. I. V. Golf filed for Chapter eleven bankruptcy protection in the federal district court of New Jersey on Tuesday. At least forty-five million dollars is owed to fourteen current and former players for the third quarter of twenty twenty-six.
The filing follows a decision in April by Saudi Arabia's Public Investment Fund to pull its multibillion-dollar funding. The fund spent more than five billion dollars since the league launched in twenty twenty-one. Court documents estimate L. I. V. assets between one hundred million and five hundred million dollars. Liabilities are estimated between five hundred million and one billion dollars.
Two-time major winner, Jon Rahm tops the list of the thirty largest unsecured creditors. His claim is seven point five million dollars. Bryson DeChambeau follows at five point seven million dollars. Dustin Johnson is owed five point five million dollars. Cameron Smith is owed four point eight million dollars. Tyrrell Hatton is owed three point four million dollars. Brooks Koepka is owed one point seven million dollars.
The Public Investment Fund is providing a forty-nine point six million dollar bankruptcy loan to help fund the restructuring process. L. I. V. found a new proposed investor in B. C. Partners. The league intends to launch a new majority player-owned league early next year under a more sustainable business model. Field sizes will expand to seventy-five players. The league will introduce a cut and lower prize purses than the P. G. A. Tour.
Previous player contracts will finish due to the court filing. Players now have the option to leave without any obligation to sign on to the new league. Speaking before the Irish Open on Tuesday, Jon Rahm told the B. B. C. that he still has a contract with L. I. V. one point zero that he is more than willing to fulfil. He added that time will tell.

item.title: GOG brings back "big box" PC games, one printable template at a time
item.description:
The personal computer gaming platform G. O. G. is bringing back nostalgia for physical game packaging. They are introducing downloadable three D models and printable box scans for games on their store.
The new Printable Big Box collection currently includes five games. Those games are Armikrog, Descent, Hitman Codename forty-seven, Myst, and Star Trek Twenty-fifth Anniversary.
Players who own these titles on G. O. G. will find three D boxes listed among their goodies. Owners can download a zipped file containing the box art as an animated G. L. B. object file.
The file also includes flat printable templates in P. D. F., S. V. G., and Adobe Illustrator formats. G. O. G. describes the templates as a proper papercraft project for users who miss traditional shelves of computer game boxes.
G. O. G. stated that physical media does not survive the way software can. Boxes get lost, crushed, or thrown out. Scanning them and letting you print your own is preservation in a different shape. It is the same mission that keeps these games running on modern personal computers, applied to the objects they used to come in.

item.title: Mourinho's Real Madrid edge Inter Milan in Champions League opener
item.description: Jose Mourinho started his Champions League campaign with Real Madrid by defeating his former side Inter Milan two to one at the Santiago Bernabeu on Tuesday. Real Madrid president Florentino Perez brought back Jose Mourinho to stop the rot after two trophy-less seasons. The record fifteen-time European champions capitalized on two first-half defensive errors to take a two-goal lead. In the fourteenth minute, a poor pass placed Yann Bisseck under pressure, allowing Brahim Diaz to poke the ball through to Kylian Mbappe, who fired home the opening goal. Real Madrid added a second when Inter goalkeeper Josep Martinez dallied on the ball, enabling Fede Valverde to pry it away and score. Cristian Chivu and his Inter side responded in the second half when Carlos Augusto smashed home a shot past Thibaut Courtois from Lautaro Martinez and his cross in the seventy-seventh minute. Despite the Italians starting energetically in attack and trying to find a foothold through Alessandro Bastoni and Henrikh Mkhitaryan, Courtois made crucial saves to deny Marcus Thuram and other visiting players. Inter goalkeeper Martinez also recovered from his earlier error to make sensational stops against Mbappe and Jude Bellingham to keep the visitors in the match. The victory gets Mourinho off to a triumphant start in the league phase following his return to the club, bouncing back from a recent La Liga defeat at Real Betis.

item.title: Waterlogged seeds reveal melons' ancient journey
item.description:
Ancient melons in East Asia likely arrived from South Asia. They did not develop from wild Chinese plants. They also lacked the sweetness of modern dessert melons.
Researchers analyzed ancient DNA from waterlogged melon seeds. The seeds were discovered during a twenty twenty-four excavation at the Shuomen Gugang medieval port in Wenzhou, China. The site dates back to the Song dynasty, which ran from nine sixty to twelve seventy-nine.
Genomic analysis showed the historical melons featured light-green flesh and a yellow peel. This made them closer to vegetables or mildly sweet fruit rather than high-sugar dessert crops.
The study notes a connection between the melons and local aesthetics. The light-green flesh color likely resonated with Song dynasty preferences for jade. This preference was mirrored in locally crafted, melon-shaped green celadon ceramics.
Co-author, Xinyi Liu, stated that this represents a rare and compelling case of cultural-genetic symbiosis. It is reflected in the parallel historical selection of melon traits and celadon aesthetics.

item.title: Sony isn’t phasing out discs quite as quickly as we thought
item.description:
Sony is still planning to end video game discs in January twenty twenty-eight. The company is not shutting down production as quickly as people thought. Two months ago reports suggested Sony was already repurposing its last disc making plant. Now the disc making division has clarified a widely reported detail.
Originally it appeared that the division president said the Thalgau plant would produce ninety percent fewer discs in twenty twenty-eight. However, an unnamed Sony D. A. D. C. spokesperson told game journalist Brian Crecente a different story. The facility will only produce ten percent fewer discs in twenty twenty-eight.
The spokesperson gave a statement to the journalist. The statement explained the actual figure is a ten percent reduction by twenty twenty-eight compared to current output. This is very different from the ninety percent reduction that was previously communicated.

item.title: Common painkiller use in early pregnancy linked to smaller ovaries and testes
item.description:
A new study in Human Reproduction Open links paracetamol use in early pregnancy to smaller reproductive organs in infants. Girls exposed to the drug as a fetus had forty percent smaller ovaries by volume.
Researchers studied six hundred eighty-five pregnant women recruited during their first trimester. These women reported medicine use every two weeks. Higher doses caused a larger effect. No participants exceeded the recommended daily maximum of four thousand milligrams.
The team also saw a reduction in average testicular volume in infant boys. Data from twelve hundred ten girls born in Copenhagen between nineteen ninety-seven and two thousand two showed a link between fetal exposure and smaller ovaries during adolescence.
Researcher, Margit Bistrup Fischer at Copenhagen University Hospital Rigshospitalet stated the findings do not prove causation. She advised pregnant women to discuss when the drug is necessary and consider nonpharmacological alternatives for mild discomfort.
Other experts cautioned that the findings do not establish a causal relationship. They noted results could stem from chance, underlying conditions, or confounding factors.
Researchers emphasized that medical advice for high fevers or strong pain remains unchanged. It is still unclear whether these infant organ size reductions affect fertility in adulthood.

item.title: Huawei launches Mate XT 2 tri-fold two days before Apple's foldable iPhone
item.description:
Huawei unveiled the Mate XT two tri-folding phone on Monday. It goes on sale in China on September tenth. This lands just two days before Apple is expected to reveal its first foldable iPhone on September ninth.
The Mate XT two features a ten point two inch display. It packs a battery above six thousand milliamp hours. It includes a redesigned hinge to soften the screen crease. It runs on a Kirin nine zero five zero Pro chip built on Huawei's own newer process.
Xiaomi also recently launched its eighteen Fold at around eight thousand nine hundred ninety-nine yuan. It runs a proprietary Xring O three chip with L. P. D. D. R. six memory. It features a seven point six inch folding display. It has a two hundred megapixel main camera and sixty-seven watt wired charging.
Two Chinese manufacturers are shipping flagship foldables on domestically designed silicon. This is the story underneath the launch calendar. Huawei keeps advancing under sanctions while Xiaomi builds that capability.
Apple’s expected foldable device features a seven point eight inch inner screen. It has a five point three inch cover display and no telephoto lens. It uses Touch ID in the power button instead of Face ID. It has an anticipated price above two thousand dollars.
Huawei’s distribution remains constrained by the lack of Google services. This keeps its phones out of Europe and the United States in meaningful volumes. It concentrates the competition with Apple inside China where Apple's market share faces sustained pressure.
Pricing outside China for the Mate XT two has not been published. Apple has not yet officially announced its foldable device.

item.title: What are the major changes coming to Apple HomeKit in iOS 27?
item.description:
Apple is bringing major updates to the Home app and HomeKit with the release of I. O. S. twenty-seven. The update is highlighted by deep integration with A. I.
The software introduces smarter notifications that can summarize important events. These events include door movements or smoke detection to prevent lock screen congestion. This helps users who have multiple cameras and smart doorbells.
Security camera footage now supports four K recording. It utilizes A. I. for improved face and animal detection. The Home app can combine footage from multiple cameras. This shows a sequence of a person moving through rooms.
For Apple TV owners, the I. O. S. twenty-seven Home app adds a new ability. You can update software across all household Apple TVs simultaneously. There are also overall improvements to app reliability.
Rumored upcoming hardware includes a new HomePod mini. Another device is a combined HomePod and iPad called the HomePad. Apple is also working on a tabletop robot that may not be ready for a while.

item.title: Run Cursor Cloud Agents on Machines You Manage
item.description:
Cursor has released new capabilities allowing teams to run its A. I.-powered Cloud Agents on dynamically scheduled pools of machines within their own networks. This replaces running them exclusively on Cursor-hosted virtual machines. Cursor states that cloud agents currently create more than sixty percent of the pull requests it merges internally. The new feature addresses the growing need for enterprises to control where agents execute and what infrastructure they use.
Under the self-hosted setup, the agent loop, inference, and planning remain in the Cursor cloud. Tool execution moves to machines managed by the user, such as laptops, virtual machines, or infrastructure provided by partners. These partners include A. W. S. Lambda, Cloudflare, Coder, Daytona, E2B, Modal, Namespace, and Vercel. To register a machine, users install the Cursor C. L. I. and run the agent worker start command. This establishes a long-lived outbound H. T. T. P. S. connection to the Cursor cloud. Cursor never initiates a connection into the user network.
The system supports individual personal workflows through My Machines and scaled enterprise needs through Pools. Pools are named queues of workers. A controller watches the request queue and uses a team-supplied spawn script to automatically start machines as demand rises. It disconnects them when they are idle. To manage costs and startup times, teams can configure idle timeouts and hibernation features. These features snapshot and stop idle machines, allowing them to restore with full state if a follow-up arrives.
Linux workers now support computer use alongside Macs. Integrations like Namespace Devboxes provide real Macs running on Apple silicon. Cursor-hosted environments remain the default option. They provide dedicated virtual machines with per-agent isolation, secret redaction, egress controls, and signed commits.

item.title: WeWorm
item.description:
Security firm Calif has released a demo of a new threat called WeWorm. It is the first zero click worm to spread through WeChat calls across I. O. S. and Android devices. Working with A. I., the team found a memory corruption bug in the app. They built a remote code execution exploit in about two days. Then they built the worm in one more week.
The exploit lets an attacker on a victim friend list hijack a WeChat account while the phone is ringing. The user does not need to answer or touch the device at all. By compromising one account, the worm can automatically call and infect other contacts on both Android and I. O. S. platforms.
Calif reported the vulnerability to Tencent in July of twenty twenty-six. Tencent confirmed on August twenty-eighth that the exploit had been fixed on the server side for all users. Calif is keeping full technical details secret until an upcoming conference. The research highlights how A. I. is lowering the barrier for creating sophisticated cyber threats.

item.title: .gitignore everything by default
item.description: An alternative Git workflow proposes a new approach. It blocks all files in a repository by default. Then it explicitly allows only necessary project files. The method prevents accidental commits of junk files and environment variables. It also stops local configurations like system store files and code editor folders. A sample configuration for a Go project demonstrates the syntax. It uses an asterisk to ignore everything. Then it adds specific exceptions prefixed with exclamation points. These exceptions include the ignore file itself and source code files. They also include the read me file and module files. This ensures that only allowed files are tracked by Git. Developers can use a specific check command to verify if a path is ignored. The technique may not suit every single repository. However it offers a way to manage projects that accumulate large numbers of local documents. It helps with massive ignore lists like the two hundred seven line ignore file used by typescript-go.

item.title: Inside the megakernel serving engine for North Mini Code
item.description: Cohere introduces a new serving engine for North Mini Code centered around a decode megakernel. Operating in B. F. sixteen on a single H. one hundred, the system attains two hundred ninety-two tokens per second at batch size one, reaching sixty-two percent of Speed-of-Light bandwidth, which is calculated at approximately four hundred seventy tokens per second. This makes it one point five eight times faster than v. L. L. M. Across end-to-end benchmarks, it runs one point two five to one point four one times faster than v. L. L. M., holding across batch sizes and out to two hundred fifty-six K of context with no measurable loss of accuracy. The system supports continuous batching, paged attention, ragged sequence lengths, and an Open A. I. compatible endpoint with tool calling, and users can explore the code on GitHub or point OpenCode at it. North Mini Code is a thirty billion parameter model featuring three point three billion active parameters per token. In B. F. sixteen, this entails streaming six point six gigabytes of weights per decode step, alongside roughly zero point five gigabytes of K. V. cache at an eight thousand context. An H. one hundred provides three point three five terabytes per second of bandwidth via H. B. M., whereas the v. L. L. M. framework serves the model at one hundred eighty-five tokens per second, achieving thirty-nine percent of Speed-of-Light. This performance gap arises because autoregressive decoding is memory-bound rather than compute-bound. Traditional serving stacks launch numerous small kernels sequentially, leaving streaming multiprocessors idle during gaps. The megakernel addresses this by running the entire forward pass as a single persistent kernel launched across streaming multiprocessors, implemented as a single C. U. D. A. file without a compiler or new programming paradigm. Drawing on pioneering work by Hazy Research titled "Look Ma, No Bubbles!", the system employs a task interpreter pattern and global memory counters for fine-grained synchronization. It also features weight prefetching that streams immutable weights from H. B. M. before activation dependencies resolve.

item.title: Gemini overlay gets bubble minimization and multitasking on Android
item.description:
Google is rolling out a new multitasking feature for the Artificial Intelligence, A. I., Gemini overlay on Android. Users can now minimize the interface into a floating bubble shortcut with the spark logo. A minimize button appears above the container. It centers itself right after a user enters a prompt. It then shifts to a pill-shaped container on the right side once the response loads.
Google explains that the assistant remains available while you multitask. Users can tap to expand the bubble. They can also drag it to move it or dismiss it entirely. The bubble currently stays fixed in one of six positions. It also has a current bug. The bug resets its location to the bottom right corner after every single minimization.
This shortcut offers a much faster alternative than opening the main Gemini app and side panel. Users can ask a question and minimize the screen immediately to perform other tasks. They no longer need to wait around for the response to finish loading.
Users can also utilize system Bubble options from Android seventeen with the Gemini app for a much richer experience. The new minimize button and the Gemini bubble are widely rolling out on Android today.

item.title: 220M Traveler Records Exposed in Vietnam-Linked APIS Leak
item.description:
A massive database containing traveler and crew records was exposed online. Researchers at, Kinryū Labs discovered the leak.
The exposed database held over two hundred twenty million records. It leaked due to a chain of security misconfigurations.
The researchers found the exposed cluster on June third. They were surveying databases as part of research into ransomware activity.
The cluster was hosted in Hanoi. It held approximately one hundred seven gigabytes of data across twenty-nine indices.
The records included over two hundred ten million passenger entries. They also included over ten million crew entries.
The data spanned from January twenty-fourseen to April twenty twenty-six.
The exposed information featured names and dates of birth. It also included sex and nationalities and passport numbers.
Other exposed fields included document expiration dates and issuing countries. Flight numbers and airlines were also exposed.
Departure and destination airports were in the data. Seat assignments and baggage references and flight times were exposed too.
Sample records reviewed by BleepingComputer included travelers of various nationalities. These included Korean and Chinese and Canadian and New Zealand nationalities.
The researchers accessed the database by chaining two misconfigurations. They overcame an initial H. T. T. P. four hundred one unauthorized response.
They used a cloud-based path that accepted default credentials.
An internet intelligence platform named, FOFA first recorded the host and port in October twenty twenty-two. The exact duration of the exposure remains unknown.
Kinryū Labs reported the vulnerability to Vietnamese authorities on June third. They also reported it to airlines and national computer emergency response teams.
Access to the database was remediated on June eighth. Singapore Airlines security team helped secure it.
Vietnamese authorities did not respond to requests for comment. It remains unclear whether malicious actors accessed or copied the data before it was secured.
Researchers found no server logs or ransom notes. They also found no unfamiliar indices.

item.title: >10x More Efficient Pretraining
item.description: Magic announced that its pretraining recipe is now more than ten times more compute-efficient than leading open-weight base models. It matches the DeepSeek V four Pro Base using roughly fifty times fewer floating-point operations. Their goal is to build the best model for coding and autonomous A. I. research and development. They plan to do this through pretraining and agentic reinforcement learning alongside long-context capabilities. According to the company, this initial efficiency equals about half of G. P. T. dash three's pretraining compute. That is roughly zero point five million dollars on G. B. two hundred hardware. After scaling up ten times further at a cost of around four million dollars, the company reported outperforming all publicly available open base models on perplexity evaluations. By comparison, Magic stated that under DeepSeek V four Pro's recipe, training a model of equivalent capability would cost more than one hundred million dollars. To measure these capabilities without prompt sensitivity, the team tracked bits-per-byte loss on held-out data. They also evaluated models across one hundred sixty-seven domains. The company's future roadmap focuses on scaling long-horizon reinforcement learning. They are also developing alignment techniques with robust theoretical properties while preparing to release their upcoming models.

item.title: Camera app in iOS 27 reportedly includes four major pro photography features
item.description:
Code found in the latest I. O. S. twenty-seven beta by developer pdfu points to four major professional photography and videography features coming to the stock camera app.
The discovered features include exposure scopes utilizing histograms and waveforms for accurate visual exposure.
Another feature is focus peaking to highlight in-focus areas with an overlay.
Users will also get highlight clipping indicators using zebra stripes to warn of overexposure.
The final feature is true manual focus via a slider which may be limited to upcoming new iPhone models.
None of the features are currently enabled in any of the I. O. S. twenty-seven betas.
The introduction of these powerful tools normally associated with professional cameras may change the tendency of keen photographers and videographers to use third-party apps instead of the stock Apple camera.

item.title: Hackers Breach F5 BIG-IP APM Devices to Deploy Linux Rootkit
item.description: Attackers are targeting F5 B. I. G. dash I. P. A. P. M. environments with a new Linux rootkit. Security researchers from Sophos and E. S. E. T. track this malware as PoisonedRefresh. The attackers likely deployed the payload after exploiting C. V. E. dash twenty twenty-five dash fifty-three five hundred twenty-one. This is a critical remote code execution flaw. F. S. Networks reclassified it from a denial-of-service problem in March. The malicious installer infected the Apache executable on B. I. G. dash I. P. A. P. M. systems. It also modified S. E. Linux configurations and maintained persistence across B. I. G. dash I. P. A. P. M. upgrade images. Sophos researchers stated that the second-stage sample hides key operational strings with R. C. four. It gains execution before the host application main function is invoked by intercepting libc start main. The malware targets the Apache P. H. P. module by hooking the Apache Portable Runtime module loader. Then it injects a P. H. P. web shell into memory. The implant intercepts P. H. P. file operations. It hides the web shell inside legitimate scripts like apm css dot php three and full wt dot php three and webtop popup css dot php three. This leaves files on disk unchanged to reduce detection. The injected web shell processes magic requests. It executes them via P. H. P. eval and returns an H. T. T. P. two hundred one response disguised as C. S. S. content. The rootkit also includes a protection mechanism. It delays local backdoor creation to prevent service disruption. Furthermore it creates a password-protected local communication socket. This socket launches an interactive Bash shell without using a T. C. P. listening port. The ShadowServer Foundation reported that seven hundred ninety-five vulnerable F. S. B. I. G. dash I. P. A. P. M. endpoints were exposed online yesterday. Defenders are advised to investigate unusual P. O. S. T. requests to targeted dot php three endpoints. They should also look for responses combining H. T. T. P. two hundred one with a text slash c. s. s. content type.

item.title: Pretraining progress is mostly coming from data
item.description:
Data improvements contributed three point two four times more compute efficiency gains than model improvements at a compute budget of one e nineteen F. L. O. P. s. This was found in an investigation into A. I. pretraining progress from twenty nineteen to twenty twenty-five. Specifically, data improvements yielded a twelve point zero times gain in efficiency. Model improvements yielded a three point seven times gain in efficiency.
Researchers trained combinations of year-representative model recipes and public data corpuses. The recipes spanned from G. P. T. two to O. L. M. o. two. The data sources ranged from OpenWebText in twenty nineteen at roughly nine billion tokens to twenty twenty-five sources like UltraFineWeb. Training runs were conducted across compute budgets of one e seventeen, three point one six e seventeen, one e eighteen, three point one six e eighteen, and one e nineteen F. L. O. P. s. End capabilities were evaluated using the O. L. M. E. S. aggregate of ten mostly multiple-choice Q. A. benchmarks.
The findings indicate that gains from data and model improvements are mostly independent and additive. Eighty-eight percent of the variance in O. L. M. E. S. scores is explained by their combined effects using a linear model.
The results suggest that much of the pretraining progress stemmed from data engineering. However, the researchers noted that model improvements primarily served to make larger amounts of compute usable by removing scaling constraints. They compared data improvements to cargo and model improvements to the structural capacity of a container ship. Ryan Greenblatt noted that historical data improvements resemble progress that automated researchers could test empirically. Future research directions include running the experiment at larger scales, measuring the marginal value of novel high-quality data, and evaluating the effectiveness of synthetic data.

item.title: GPS collars reveal secrets of the power struggle between lions and hyenas in the wild
item.description:
New research published in Frontiers in Ethology details how G. P. S. collars mapped the movements of African lions and spotted hyenas. This research overturns the long-held assumption that hyenas simply shadow lions for food scraps. Lead author Doctor Nancy Barker of the University of KwaZulu-Natal and her colleagues tracked seventeen lions and fourteen spotted hyenas. The tracking took place over a four-year period across Etosha National Park in Namibia and Chobe National Park and the adjoining Linyanti Conservancy in Botswana.
Researchers analyzed G. P. S. fixes taken every five minutes during peak activity hours. They identified twenty-three pairs of simultaneously tracked animals including ten lion-hyena pairs. The data revealed that spotted hyenas consistently move away from lions. Meanwhile, male lions tend to move toward hyenas.
Barker noted that while male lions actively approach hyenas, females show more ambivalence. This reaction depends on the presence of other pride members. Barker stated that G. P. S. collar data show African lions and spotted hyenas leave a clear and measurable signature in the way they move around one another.
The hyena retreat signal was consistent across three independent statistical tests. Researchers concluded it reflects a repeatable behavioral pattern of interference competition and asymmetric coordination.

item.title: Babies born to anaemic mothers have smaller brains, study finds
item.description: Babies born to mothers with mild anaemia have lower total brain volume and smaller brains in key regions. These regions are linked to movement and learning and emotion regulation. This is according to a new study published in the journal Brain Communications. Researchers from King’s College London and the University of Cape Town followed more than three hundred mothers and their infants in Cape Town. They scanned the babies brains several times between three months and two years of age. On average, the total brain volume of infants born to anaemic mothers was four percent lower than that of other babies. Specific differences were recorded in the putamen and the caudate nucleus and the corpus callosum. The size gap between the two groups widened over the first two years of life. The corpus callosum measured about four percent smaller at twelve months and six percent smaller by twenty-four months. First author, Jessica Ringshaw noted that earlier research showed these brain differences persist when children are six years old and starting school. This can potentially translate into noticeable cognitive difficulties. More than a third of pregnant women worldwide have anaemia. The condition is typically caused by iron deficiency. Jessica Ringshaw emphasized the need for screening and iron supplementation during pregnancy alongside infection management. She stated that anaemia needs to be placed at the forefront of public health efforts. The study utilized portable low-field M. R. I. scanners. These machines proved sensitive enough to detect the same brain differences as traditional high-field machines. Steve Williams, a professor of neuroimaging at King’s, said the study proved that this novel technology can measure the impact of malnutrition on the developing brain at scale in challenging environments.

item.title: US strikes Iranian oil tankers as Tehran targets American base in Jordan
item.description:
United States forces struck five Iranian oil tankers on Tuesday. They sank one tanker named, M/T Riesco. This followed two separate Iranian attempts to target an American warship.
United States Central Command stated that four of the targeted oil tankers were in the Gulf of Oman. They were linked to Iran's Revolutionary Guards Corps. Another tanker was targeted near Kharg Island. Ninety percent of the country's crude oil passes through that part of the Gulf.
In retaliation, Iran launched twenty missiles at a United States base in Jordan. The Jordanian Armed Forces reported shooting down eighteen missiles. Two missiles fell in unpopulated areas.
The Revolutionary Guards also stated they attacked two United States vessels. They claimed to hit eight oil tankers and ten non-compliant vessels in the Strait of Hormuz. No American troops were harmed during the attacks.
The strikes followed an earlier incident where Iran claimed to have seized a malfunctioning uncrewed United States submarine. United States Navy Captain, Tim Hawkins noted the recovered underwater drone was an older model. It carried no classified equipment.
The latest exchanges follow more than six months of escalation. This started after initial United States and Israeli attacks on Iran on February twenty-eighth.
The United States military justified Tuesday's maritime strikes. They identified the targeted tankers as part of a multi-billion-dollar shadow network. This network funds the I. R. G. C. and regional proxies.
United States Secretary of State, Marco Rubio stated that Iran will lose a tanker every time they try to hit United States naval ships.
Regional instability widened on Tuesday. Yemen's Iran-backed Houthi movement launched drone and missile attacks. They targeted energy and civilian infrastructure in Saudi Arabia. The attacks injured seventy-three people. They caused temporary halts at oil facilities.
The growing conflict pushed oil markets higher in Asia trading. Benchmark Brent crude rose one point five percent to ninety-nine dollars and thirty-five cents a barrel. United States traded oil increased one point three percent to ninety-four dollars and twenty-three cents.

item.title: 4 floors higher, Rs 4 lakh a month: The greed behind Delhi PG ‘Hostel Daze’
item.description:
On September sixth, a five-storey paying guest accommodation collapsed in south Delhi's Satya Niketan. The disaster killed seven people and exposed widespread safety risks in student housing across the capital.
According to the police first information report, building owner Hariram Gupta and his brother constructed four unauthorized floors on the forty-year-old structure. They wanted to increase rental income and generated more than four lakh rupees monthly. Investigators found that a load-bearing wall was allegedly removed while two ground-floor shops were being merged. The building had been leased to paying guest operator Hostel Daze in August twenty twenty-five. Hariram Gupta was apprehended following raids across Gurgaon using technical surveillance and a look-out circular.
The tragedy has deeply rattled students and young professionals who rely on paying guest housing near Delhi University and employment hubs. Resident Sneha Mishra from Deoghar, Jharkhand, told reporters that the incident has shattered her sense of security. She asked what if the building we trust with our lives is not safe. Other residents highlighted how tight budgets force them to compromise on safety. They noted that management often fails to show regulatory documents or address basic structural concerns.
Meanwhile, the Delhi government is working on a comprehensive policy to regulate paying guest accommodations. Urban Development Minister Ashish Sood outlined the proposed measures. The framework mandates municipal and police verification, operating licenses, and closed-circuit television cameras with thirty days of storage. It requires night guards for paying guest facilities housing fifteen or more students. It also establishes a Rent Regulation Committee to set area-specific rent bands.

item.title: TSA brings back gate access for some people without plane tickets 25 years after 9/11
item.description:
The Transportation Security Administration is launching a new program called Gateside by T. S. A. PreCheck. This program allows eligible members without plane tickets to pass through security and enter gate areas. This initiative brings back a pre-nine-eleven tradition that ended nearly twenty-five years ago.
The free program is initially available at thirteen airports. These include Los Angeles International Airport and Dallas-Fort Worth International Airport. They also include Harry Reid International Airport in Las Vegas and Salt Lake City International Airport. The T. S. A. plans to expand the program to additional airports in the coming months.
Interested members must apply online one to three days before their planned visits. They must receive approval before heading to the airport. Approved individuals can use a T. S. A. PreCheck lane with an acceptable form of identification.
The passes are valid for one calendar day. They allow for reentries on that same day. Members of other trusted-traveler programs who possess a Known Traveler Number are also eligible to apply.
The T. S. A. stated this initiative serves as an exclusive benefit for trusted travelers. It makes it easier to return to the gate for welcomes and send-offs. It helps people meet friends during a layover and enjoy airport dining and shopping.

item.title: Iran says it hit American vessels, oil tankers in Hormuz in retaliation for U.S. strikes
item.description:
Iran's Revolutionary Guards Corps said they struck two American vessels and eight oil tankers in the Gulf. This was retaliation against the United States for destroying five Iranian tankers. The Guards stated the targeted vessels tried to cross a forbidden area of the Hormuz Strait.
United States Central Command reported that the American military destroyed five Iranian crude oil tankers on Tuesday. This happened after the Iranian Guard fired ballistic missiles at an American warship twice over the past two days. The targeted American warship successfully evaded the attack and no American personnel were harmed.
Central Command stated that United States forces struck four tankers in the Gulf of Oman. These were named the M T Kaviz, the M T Charminar, the M T Horizon one, and the M T Riesco. They also struck the M T Derya near Iran's Kharg Island. American forces directed the crews to abandon ship before rendering the vessels inoperable.
This exchange follows the United States military destroying three Iranian tankers on Saturday. That action was in response to the Guard firing ballistic missiles at an aircraft carrier and a guided-missile destroyer. The escalating conflict along a critical oil corridor has pushed Brent crude to near one hundred dollars a barrel.
Iranian Foreign Minister, Abbas Araghchi, dismissed United States sanctions on the platform X as a rehash of a failed strategy.
In a separate incident on Tuesday, Central Command addressed an unmanned submersible that Iran reportedly seized in the Strait of Hormuz. United States Navy Captain, Tim Hawkins, stated that an underwater drone operated by United States forces malfunctioned more than a day ago while surveying regional waters. Hawkins dismissed the captured craft as an older and defective model. It carried no classified sonar or radar equipment and collected no sensitive data.
Iranian media outlets identified the sub as a Dive-L-D autonomous undersea vehicle developed by Anduril. The craft costs two point five million dollars each according to a twenty twenty-four DefenseScoop report. An Anduril spokesperson noted that the Dive-L-D is an attritable autonomous system designed to operate in dangerous environments where loss is expected.

item.title: Delhi Satya Niketan building collapse: PG operator arrested, adjacent unsafe building demolished | Top updates
item.description: Delhi Police arrested Sudhanshu. He is an operator of the Hostel Daze paying guest facility inside a five-storey building. The building in Delhi's Satya Niketan area collapsed on Sunday afternoon, September sixth, twenty twenty-five. The disaster resulted in seven fatalities, including five students. Sudhanshu and his business partner Shubham Tyagi had leased the property in August twenty twenty-five. Shubham remains at large. Police are investigating the circumstances of the collapse and the roles of those linked to the ownership, maintenance, repair work, and paying guest operations. Repair work had been underway in the building basement for eight to ten days before the collapse. Police previously arrested property owners Hariram Bansal, who is eighty-one, and his wife Urmila Gupta, who is seventy-five. They arrested their fifty-two-year-old son Mahesh Gupta as well. The older couple was placed in fourteen-day judicial custody. Mahesh was remanded to two days of police custody. Authorities also apprehended labor contractor Sanoj from Kasganj, Uttar Pradesh, who was allegedly supervising the basement repairs. A building contractor and a mason are also being produced in court. Delhi Chief Minister Rekha Gupta ordered the demolition of the adjacent dilapidated building to ensure public safety. The Delhi C. M. O. stated on X that Delhi Fire Service personnel are systematically removing students' belongings from that adjacent structure. The Supreme Court will examine the collapse on a pan-India basis. A bench of Justices Ahsanuddin Amanullah and R. Mahadevan listed the matter for a hearing on Thursday following a mention by senior advocate and amicus curiae Ajit Sinha.

item.title: Why Nepal is demanding climate justice and compensation after deadly floods
item.description: Nepal is demanding climate justice and twenty million dollars in compensation. This follows catastrophic floods on August twenty-sixth that killed more than one thousand three hundred people. The disaster left over five thousand people missing. It was triggered when a mountain glacier collapsed. A torrent of water and mud rushed into Nepal. It hit the Rasuwa region and the Nuwakot region, as well as China. Foreign Minister, Shisir Khanal, stated that Nepal is paying the ultimate price for a global crisis. He emphasized that support should be viewed as climate justice rather than charity. President, Ramchandra Paudel, echoed this appeal in an address to the nation on Monday. Nepal observed a national day of mourning for the victims on that same day. The Ministry of Finance and the Ministry of Environment wrote a joint letter to the United Nations. They requested twenty million dollars in damages. The United Nations Loss and Damage Fund faces a two point eight billion dollar funding gap. This gap exists as the fund prepares to approve its first climate recovery projects. Nepal contributes less than zero point one percent of global greenhouse gas emissions. Yet its glaciers have lost close to one-third of their volume in roughly three decades due to global warming. Preliminary estimates from the National Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Authority put property and housing and infrastructure losses at some two point five six billion dollars.

item.title: Eiffel Tower row over Hindu sect BAPS unites French politicians – but divides Indian diaspora
item.description:
The Eiffel Tower was closed on Monday after staff went on strike. Female workers were removed and replaced by men during a private tour. The tour was for a Bochasanwasi Akshar Purushottam Swaminarayan Sanstha delegation.
The incident united French politicians across the political spectrum in commenting on the fracas. This happened ahead of the twenty twenty-seven election. Socialist Paris Mayor Emmanuel Grégoire promised an investigation. Île-de-France president Valérie Pécresse expressed shock. Far-right leader Marine Le Pen stated that France would never accept that the presence of women be limited.
Progressive diaspora Indians had held a public meeting on Saturday to raise awareness. They talked about the sect's conservative and misogynistic practices and ties to Hindu nationalism. They warned that the Eiffel Tower story must not become fodder for more racism and far-right backlash.
B. A. P. S. released a statement apologizing for any pain or inconvenience. They noted that to their knowledge access to the monument was never denied to anyone.
Indian Foreign Ministry spokesperson Randhir Jaiswal called the matter purely between the concerned entities.
The B. A. P. S. Hindu sect inaugurated Europe's largest traditional temple on Sunday. It is located in Bussy-Saint-Georges, a Paris suburb. Indian Prime Minister Narendra Modi delivered a virtual message. He hailed the new temple as a symbol of bilateral cooperation.

item.title: US Open 2026 quarter-final: Ben Shelton v Carlos Alcaraz goes to final set – live
item.description:
At two fifty-one a.m. during the U. S. Open quarter-final at Arthur Ashe Stadium, Ben Shelton and Carlos Alcaraz pushed their match past the previous tournament record for a latest finish.
The previous record had been set at two fifty a.m. by Alcaraz and Jannik Sinner during their twenty twenty-two quarter-final.
Carlos Alcaraz won that twenty twenty-two match six to three, six to seven, six to seven, seven to five, and six to three after five hours and fifteen minutes.
The current match advanced to a fifth and deciding set after Shelton claimed the third set and Alcaraz fought back.
Earlier in the contest, Alcaraz secured the opening set six to three in a sixty-one-minute battle that included a first-set tiebreak.
Shelton subsequently claimed the second set in forty-nine minutes, leveling the match at one set apiece, before taking the third set in forty-eight minutes.
Alcaraz then forced the fifth set, with his performance featuring thirty-seven unforced errors through the early stages of the match and a first-serve percentage that dipped to fifty percent in the second set.
Shelton relied heavily on a powerful serve that topped out at one hundred forty-nine miles per hour and reached speeds of one hundred forty-four miles per hour and one hundred forty-two miles per hour at critical moments.
Shelton also won sixty-eight percent of his first-serve points and converted key break opportunities against the Spaniard.

item.title: Tamil Nadu CM Vijay to travel to London on first official overseas visit; gold ring scheme launch postponed
item.description:
Tamil Nadu Chief Minister C. Joseph Vijay will take his first official overseas trip on Thursday, September tenth, twenty twenty-six. He is traveling to London to attract investments and meet with entrepreneurs and industrialists.
Mister Vijay leaves from Chennai airport on the night of September tenth and arrives in London on September eleventh. His return to Chennai is planned for the morning of September seventeenth.
During his week-long United Kingdom trip, he will highlight the state investment potential. Officials expect him to witness the signing of important memoranda of understanding between the Tamil Nadu government and multinational companies.
This follows the recent Vettri Tamil Nadu Investors Conclave. That event secured agreements with ninety-seven companies for investments worth sixty-seven thousand four hundred and eighty-two crore rupees.
The Chief Minister will also tour motorsport facilities and a circuit in London. This follows his recent assembly announcement to build a motorsport city in Tamil Nadu.
He will hold discussions with members of the Tamil diaspora during the journey. Secretaries one and four will accompany him along with senior officials of Guidance Tamil Nadu.
Sources confirmed his schedule remains unchanged despite reports of a proposed visit by Malaysian Prime Minister Anwar Ibrahim to Chennai. Because of this trip, the launch of the T. V. K. government welfare scheme named Thaimaman Thanga Mothiram Thittam has been postponed. It was originally set to launch on September fifteenth, twenty twenty-six. Additional events tied to party figures Annadurai and Ramasamy are also likely to be postponed.

item.title: BRICS leaders gather in India, but does the group have a clear purpose?
item.description:
India is hosting the eighteenth B. R. I. C. S. summit in Delhi this weekend. The slogan is Building for Resilience, Innovation, Cooperation and Sustainability. This reinterprets the original acronym for the five founding members of Brazil, Russia, India, China, and South Africa. It now includes new members Egypt, Ethiopia, Indonesia, Iran, and the United Arab Emirates. The bloc now represents nearly half the world population and about forty percent of global G. D. P.
Mihaela Papa, director of the B. R. I. C. S. Lab at the Massachusetts Institute of Technology, noted that India adds clout. It has significant geopolitical weight and relationships across competing camps. This makes it an important bridge builder.
Iranian President Masoud Pezeshkian will attend. United Arab Emirates President Sheikh Mohamed bin Zayed Al Nahyan is expected to send representatives. Saudi Arabia is also expected to attend even though its B. R. I. C. S. status remains somewhat ambiguous.
For host India, the summit serves as a platform for bilateral meetings. This includes a scheduled Friday meeting between Putin and Indian Prime Minister Narendra Modi. It is also an opportunity for Modi and Xi to speak face to face amid continued strain in the China and India relationship.
Yale University lecturer Sushant Singh stated that concrete outcomes and what is achievable will likely be very limited. B. R. I. C. S. is simply not a priority for India. India is not comfortable with any kind of anti-western line. It focuses instead on defense ties with the U. S. and trade ties with the west as a whole.
Papa expects progress this weekend specifically in trade and agriculture. Progress will also involve monetary cooperation using an alternative financial architecture for currency exchange. She noted that India is keen for a coordinated approach from B. R. I. C. S. to trade and the World Trade Organization.
However, Singh maintains that internal contradictions will continue to make consensus difficult. These include a growing number of autocracies and tense bilateral relations among members.

item.title: Family of British man found dead in Grenada ask local police to work with UK investigators
item.description:
The family of forty-seven-year-old British father Andrew Frederick is urging local authorities to cooperate with United Kingdom investigators. Frederick was found dead in Grenada on the fourth of January. His body was discovered at his rental property. A privately hired pathologist concluded that week that he was a victim of homicide. In June, the director of public prosecution in Grenada, Howard Pinnock, stated there was no basis to treat the case as a homicide. He added that it would be sent to the coroner.
After a sustained campaign by the family, British authorities became involved. The body of Frederick was repatriated to the United Kingdom last month. A second autopsy revealed his organs were missing. The United Kingdom coroner recorded his cause of death as unascertained. Last week at the West London coroner court, senior coroner Lydia Brown suspended the inquest. This happened after the Metropolitan Police launched a criminal investigation. No arrests have been made. Officers from the Metropolitan Police have contacted the Royal Grenada Police Force to offer assistance.
In a statement to the Guardian, the family said justice for Andrew depends on everyone with the power to act on both sides of the Atlantic doing what is right. They are calling on Grenadian authorities to share information and collaborate with the Metropolitan Police. They are also seeking answers regarding the absence of the organs of Frederick. The Office of the Commissioner in Grenada stated that the matter will progress to the coroner court for the parish of Saint George.

item.title: Interstellar comet 3I/ATLAS is bursting with methanol
item.description:
On September ninth, twenty twenty-six, the National Radio Astronomy Observatory announced a major discovery. Observations from the Atacama Large Millimeter/submillimeter Array show that interstellar comet three I slash ATLAS contains exceptionally high levels of methanol.
Researchers observed the comet using the Atacama Compact Array as it moved closer to the Sun. Sunlight heated the icy surface of the comet. Scientists concentrated on the submillimeter signatures of methanol and hydrogen cyanide. They measured methanol-to-H. C. N. ratios of roughly seventy and one hundred twenty on two observation dates. These values place three I slash ATLAS among the most methanol-rich comets ever studied. Its abundance exceeds almost all known comets from our own solar system.
Lead author of the research is, Nathan Roth, a professor with American University. He shared that observing three I slash ATLAS is like taking a fingerprint from another solar system. He noted that the details reveal what it is made of. He added that it is bursting with methanol in a way we just do not usually see in comets in our own solar system.
Earlier observations with the James Webb Space Telescope had already found a coma dominated by carbon dioxide while the comet was still far from the Sun. The new A. L. M. A. data revealed more secrets. Hydrogen cyanide originates mostly from the central nucleus of the comet. Methanol comes from both the nucleus and tiny icy grains floating within the coma.
Temperatures rise and these small grains act like miniature comets. They release additional methanol into the surrounding gas and dust. This marks the first time researchers have traced the detailed physics of this type of outgassing in an interstellar object.
Comet three I slash ATLAS is only the third confirmed object ever observed entering our solar system from interstellar space. It follows one I slash 'Oumuamua and two I slash Borisov.
The measurements suggest that the ice inside three I slash ATLAS formed under very different conditions. Or it was exposed to conditions that shaped most comets in our solar system differently. This offers new insight into how small icy bodies form in other planetary systems.

item.title: Batteries just broke another record in the US
item.description: Battery installations in the United States reached a record twenty point two gigawatt hours of new capacity in the second quarter of twenty twenty-six. This comes from a report by Benchmark Mineral Intelligence and the Solar Energy Industries Association. That capacity supplies the daily electricity needs of about seven hundred thousand homes. The surge puts the country on a trajectory to install seventy-one gigawatt hours of batteries this year. That is a twenty percent increase over last year. Cheaper batteries and the need for storage are driving this growth as solar and wind power join the grid. Massive utility scale systems drove the record quarter. This includes seven new gigascale installations with a capacity of over one gigawatt hour each. Shan Tomouk, energy storage and energy lead for Benchmark Mineral Intelligence, stated that it really came down to a handful of big projects. Behind the meter batteries also grew. Data centers led the commercial sector by making up about three quarters of new batteries. Residential batteries saw a sharp slowdown. Home installations are projected to drop by sixteen percent in twenty twenty-six compared to last year. Tomouk noted that this drop happened largely because a tax credit subsidizing home battery systems ended in twenty twenty-five. Home installations should recover by the end of the decade, and nonresidential tax credits have largely survived. Isshu Kikuma, an energy storage analyst at BloombergNEF, described the sector as one of the strong spots in United States energy right now. Nearly all the systems coming online use cells made in China.

item.title: Russia and Ukraine exchange strikes as two killed at Moldova border
item.description: Two people were killed when Russian drones struck the Starokozache border crossing between Ukraine and Moldova. The strike forced the facility to close. Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky stated that the aggression must be stopped here and now before it spreads any further. The overnight attack also injured three people, including a Moldovan driver. This was reported by Odesa regional head Oleh Kiper and the foreign ministry of Moldova. In the Ukrainian capital of Kyiv, a woman was killed and fourteen people were injured. That total includes two children after a Russian drone hit a nine storey residential building. In Russia, officials reported that four people were killed and twenty-nine others injured in a Ukrainian drone attack. The strike happened in the Black Sea port of Novorossiysk. Governor Veniamin Kondratiev described it as a massive overnight enemy drone attack. A child was among those killed in that port city. A drone also hit an industrial facility in the Arctic city of Novy Urengoy. That location is nearly three thousand kilometres from Ukraine. Falling wreckage triggered a fire there with no injuries reported, according to regional governor Dmitry Artyukhov. The defence ministry of Russia stated its forces shot down five hundred ninety-six Ukrainian drones overnight. The cross-border strikes occurred as Russia and Ukraine stepped up long-range attacks. This happened despite renewed diplomatic efforts following a phone call between Russian President Vladimir Putin and United States President Donald Trump about ending the war. Weekend meetings also took place in Moscow and Kyiv involving United States envoys Jared Kushner and Steve Witkoff.
